title: Field Sales Representative
description:
Build Your Own Sales Business with
is the AI-powered marketing platform built for small businesses. We handle social media, email marketing, ads, and reputation management - so local business owners can stop being reluctant marketers and get back to doing what they love.
We’re venture-backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital, growing fast, and looking for independent, ambitious sales partners across the UK who want to earn serious money introducing local businesses to Omada.
The Opportunity
This isn’t a job - it’s a partnership. As an Omada Field Sales Representative, you run your own independent sales operation. You choose your hours, your territory, your approach. We provide the product, the resources, and a compensation structure that means you’re never working for free.

• Guaranteed Weekly Draw: £500/week guaranteed minimum - as long as you’re hitting your trial targets. This isn’t commission-only.

• Commission: £250-£350 per closed account (tier-dependent) with uncapped earnings. Top partners earn £4,000-£8,000+ per month.

• Structure: Self-employed (sole trader or limited company). You invoice us. You manage your own tax.

• Location: Your local city. Must be based in the United Kingdom.

• Schedule: Entirely your own. Work when it suits you - mornings, evenings, weekends. Your business, your call.

How the Draw Works
We believe in setting our partners up for success. That’s why every Territory Partner receives a guaranteed weekly draw of £500 - as long as you’re generating results.

• Weeks 1-4: Generate at least 3 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

• Week 5 onward: Generate at least 4 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

• In any week where your commissions from closed accounts exceed £500, you earn the full commission instead

• The draw is ongoing - not just for your first month. Hit your numbers, get paid. Every week.

This means you’re never working for nothing while your pipeline builds. Trials convert to paying customers, commissions grow, and the draw becomes your floor - not your ceiling.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be visiting local businesses - salons, restaurants, gyms, coffee shops, pet groomers, dental practices - and showing them how can handle their marketing while they focus on running their business.
A typical approach might look like this:

• Identify businesses in your area that could benefit from better marketing

• Walk in and start a conversation - "Hi, I work with . Who handles your social media?"

• Show a quick demo on your phone

• Offer a 14-day free trial - no risk for them

• Follow up - when they convert, you earn your commission

We provide a resource kit with demo scripts, objection-handling guides, and territory mapping tools. How you use them is entirely up to you.
Who Thrives as a Sales Representative / Territory Partner

• Self-starters who don’t need someone managing their diary

• People comfortable walking into a business and starting a conversation

• Entrepreneurial types who want to build something, not just clock hours

• Anyone with sales, field marketing, or B2B experience (helpful but not required)

• People who want uncapped income tied to their effort, not a salary cap

What You’ll Need

• UK-based with the right to work in the United Kingdom

• Registered (or willing to register) as self-employed with HMRC

• Smartphone with internet access

• Reliable transport or a walkable territory with high business density

• The drive to build your own business

No degree required. No prior sales experience required. If you can hold a conversation and you’re willing to put in the work, we’ll provide the resources to help you succeed.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer to join our growing team. This role is ideal for a creative thinker with strong technical skills and a passion for creating seamless, user-centered digital experiences. You’ll be responsible for designing intuitive interfaces across web applications, mobile platforms, and other digital environments, while working closely with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to bring ideas to life.
The ideal candidate combines a strong aesthetic sense with an understanding of human-computer interaction and web design best practices. You should be highly collaborative, organized, and ready to lead design efforts that delight users and meet business goals.
Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the design and execution of responsive web interfaces that align with business goals, user needs, and technical constraints.

• Partner with cross-functional teams-including developers, engineers, and product managers-to gather user requirements and translate them into visually engaging and functional designs.

• Develop user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and UI specifications to effectively communicate design intent.

• Conduct and participate in usability testing, collect feedback, and refine designs based on findings.

• Ensure design consistency across products through a shared UI component library and scalable design systems.

• Maintain design integrity throughout the development lifecycle by working closely with engineering teams.

• Communicate design rationale clearly and confidently across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Navigate complex, regulated development environments with attention to compliance and usability standards.

• Stay informed on industry trends, UX best practices, and emerging technologies to continuously improve design solutions.

• Provide regular updates, reports, and documentation of design progress, challenges, and achievements.

Requirements

Must-Have

• Deep understanding of accessibility and usability standards.

• Proficiency with tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Cloud, and InVision.

• Solid experience conducting user research and usability testing.

• Minimum 3 years of experience collaborating with developers on user experience projects.

• At least 2 years in a senior or lead design role with hands-on project contributions.

• Strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals, including DOM manipulation and the JavaScript object model.

• Understanding of scalable design systems and component-based architecture.

Nice-to-Have

• Exposure to modern JavaScript frameworks (EcmaScript, TypeScript).

• Familiarity with development tools like Webpack, NPM, Babel, and version control systems (Git).

• Experience working with IDEs (e.g., WebStorm, Visual Studio Code, MS Visual Studio).

• Experience with video streaming interfaces, media playback, and protection technologies.

System and Work Setup Requirements:

• A stable and high-speed internet connection preferably 25 MBPS or higher with backup in cases of power interruption or service provider issues.

• Own PC/laptop with 8GB RAM, and a processor of Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 3 / 2013 Mac equivalent or higher; Windows 10 or above / Catalina 10.15 or newer; with up-to-date web browsers, and security software, 500GB/128 SSD storage

• Headset/earphone with noise cancellation and webcam at 720p or higher resolution

• A designated, quiet, and well-organized workspace free from distractions to facilitate focused work

Benefits

• Permanent remote work setup

• Earn a salary rate of $7-$9 per hour

• Internet Allowance

• HMO insurance (PH)

• Paid US holidays

• Paid Vacation and Sick Leaves
